#### Energy to train GPT-3

Table 4 of @patterson2021carbon gives these figures for training GPT-3:

- $3.14 \times 10^{23}$ floating-point operations in all;
- $24.6 \times 10^{12}$ operations a second on each of its V100 GPUs;
- 330 watts drawn by each GPU,
  counting its share of the memory, fans and host computer.

How much electrical energy did the GPUs use?
